scope.scenario: The new case writes an exact 4,097-byte candidate, then attempts to read it with AcpFilesystemLimits.maximumReadBytes=4,096. The write ceiling is 8 MiB and patch, source-file, staging, context, patch-count, frame, and protocol limits have headroom. The test verifies initial captured files fit within the read cap, isolating the callback read refusal after the acknowledged write.
scope.candidate: The receipt records the allowed write and resource-limit read refusal. The exact candidate reaches the injected STRICT_CONTAINED validator, which throws its expected sentinel. Receipt and rejected assessment bindings are checked; accepted source/head are unchanged; pending state is cleared; process and sandbox cleanup are verified.
